name: agent-identifier
title: Agent Identifier
notes: An important point to note is that properties of the adms:Identifier class are properties of the Identifier, not the resource that it identifies or the agency that issued it.
examples: `an ORCID`; `a Wikidata Q-number`; `an Index Herbariorum Institution Code`; `an International Standard Name Identifier`

fields.name: agent_fk
fields.title: Agent (Foreign Key)
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the related primary key.

fields.name: identifier
fields.title: Identifier
fields.description: An unambiguous reference to a resource within a given context.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to identify a resource by means of a string conforming to a formal identification system.

fields.name: identifierType
fields.title: Identifier Type
fields.description: A category or system that best matches the nature of an identifier (skos:notation).
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.

fields.name: identifierTypeIRI
fields.title: Identifier Type IRI
fields.description: An IRI of a controlled vocabulary value for a type of identifier.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI for a term in a controlled vocabulary.

fields.name: identifierTypeSource
fields.title: Identifier Type Source
fields.description: A reference to a controlled vocabulary in which the definition of a value in dwc:identifierType is given.

fields.name: identifierLanguage
fields.title: Identifier Language
fields.description: A language in which an identifier is presented.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use an ISO639-2 three-letter language code.
